name: cg_coin_markets
description:
Ranked list of coins with market data in USD from CoinGecko (coins/markets).
Returns {coins: [{id, symbol, name, current_price, market_cap, market_cap_rank, total_volume, high_24h, low_24h, price_change_percentage_24h, circulating_supply, ath, ...}]}.
Inputs (none required): order (CoinGecko's documented sorts: market_cap_desc, market_cap_asc, volume_desc, volume_asc, id_asc, id_desc; default market_cap_desc), limit (1-250; default 50). Quote currency is fixed to usd.
For specific coins use cg_coin_price; for 24h movers cg_top_gainers and cg_top_losers.
Example: {"order": "volume_desc", "limit": 20}

order.description: Sort order: market_cap_desc, market_cap_asc, volume_desc, volume_asc, id_asc or id_desc

limit.description: Number of coins (CoinGecko allows up to 250)
